_comment: Free, official or trusted news feeds used for the Market watch box (no AI involved). Every host MUST be in site/data/allowed-domains.json. A feed that fails is skipped and logged; the job only fails if NO feed works. Removed after the first real run (HTTP 403 for automated readers): bls.gov RSS and release calendar, business-standard.com. Calendars can list ICS release calendars; none is active.
